title: The Calla
subtitle: 13 ct D Flawless pear — from the Bloom Collection

stone.origin: Natural. GIA certified. Set in platinum, oriented along the line of the finger. Marquise-cut diamond petal ring beneath the centre.

description: The Calla — a single 13-carat D-flawless pear diamond, set in platinum. A ring of marquise-cut diamonds opens like petals around the pavilion, passing fire upward into the pear from below. From the Bloom Collection by Bez Ambar. Ref C0728.
